entries.title: Pool Hours — Northwest YMCA (Pima County Community Center), swim season Sept 7, 2026 – Apr 25, 2027
entries.content:
Northwest YMCA pool hours for the swim season (Sept 7, 2026 – Apr 25, 2027):
- Monday–Friday: 5:30am–11:00am (the pool CLOSES AT 11:00 AM — morning only)
- Saturday: 9:00am–1:00pm
- Sunday: Closed

IMPORTANT: the tucsonymca.org pool schedule may list the weekday close as 11:00pm — that is a typo. The Northwest pool closes at 11:00am on weekdays, not 11:00pm. Always give 11:00am; do not give 11pm or present both times.

The building/Wellness Center has different hours (Mon–Fri 5am–9pm, Sat 7am–7pm, Sun 12pm–5pm) — those are not pool hours.

Source: RJ Bergman (VP of Operations), Oct 25, 2026.
